description: Entries need vertical structure: create modules via set-project-architecture / set-module-details before or when adding entries. Set refs.moduleName to an existing module name from list-modules. Run validate after edits to find entries-without-modules, entry-unlinked, or empty slices. Max 50 entries per bulk call—split large catalogs into batches of ~50 to avoid oversized tool payloads. For full re-import: delete-entries once, then set-entries in 50-entry chunks; or replace-entries with deleteOrphans=false until the final batch (deleteOrphans=true). Set refs.moduleName per entry, or pass top-level moduleName as default. Prefer set-entries in 50-entry chunks over one huge replace-entries payload.

entries.description: Facts to upsert (max 50 per call; use multiple calls for larger catalogs)

entryIds.description: Related entry ids, e.g. flow steps pointing to other entries

files.description: Workspace-relative file paths where this fact lives

moduleName.description: Module name from list-modules; per-entry override of batch moduleName
Default refs.moduleName for entries that omit refs.moduleName

projectId.description: Required. Call list-projects first (query by workspace folder name) and pass the matching projectId. Never omit. default-project is forbidden.

name: set-entries
title: Set Entries
